CircuitGuide.From “what if” to “here’s how”.Built for curious minds.

A little guidance goes a long way.

CircuitGuide asks for your idea, budget and experience, then creates a structured electronics project plan. With a Groq key configured on the local server, it supports custom ideas and follow-up questions.

Live mode uses Groq through a local Node server. Your conversation and current plan are sent to Groq. Without a configured key, the three sample templates run in clearly labelled demo mode.

Put your key in the project’s .env file, run npm start and open http://localhost:4173. AI-generated costs are estimates, not live prices. Reference links come from a curated library; the model does not browse or verify every claim.

Guest conversations stay in this browser. When logged in, projects are saved to your account in the local SQLite database. Plans are educational starting points, with no complete schematic, current-budget verification or automatic circuit validation.
